name: The World As I Saw It
source:
A visual novel were you follow fragmented days and overlapping relationships.

Instead of a fixed route, you move between two timelines—2000 and 2006—each revealing alternate emotional versions of the same world.  Meanings drift and intimacy becomes something unstable—something that keeps changing shape, as the structure of the story unfolds, it becomes unclear whether you are uncovering the past or rewriting it through observation.

[From [url=https://4ffct.itch.io/the-world-as-i-saw-it]Itch.io[/url]]
